messages:
sophie liu: Heads-up — updated guidance for supplier contract approvals and expense handling for FY26. Small changes: purchases under $2,500 remain pro card allowed; $2,500–$25,000 requires finance approval + PO; >$25,000 requires procurement + legal review. See the short summary here: https://redwood.internal/finance/policies/contract-approval (internal).

maria gonzalez: Quick q — for growth-engineering contractors, do we treat onboarding as a separate vendor or a single vendor with multiple SOWs?

kevin choi: For Vendor: "CloudTools Inc" — they asked for a signed MSA before we issue PO. Who owns the MSA? procurement or legal?

sophie liu: Procurement owns the PO process; Legal owns MSAs. If the engagement touches customer data, loop in Security immediately. Please use the Vendor Request form (https://redwood.internal/ops/vendor-request) and tick the "requires MSA" box.

finance-bot: Automated note — new approval thresholds are effective 2026-04-01. Expense reports filed after that date will be evaluated under the new rules. Default PO template: `PO-REQ-<DEPT>-YYYY`.

david park: @sophie approved on principle from EngBudget. I'll open the vendor request for CloudTools and allocate from the infra supplier bucket — we have ~$40k remaining for Q2.

kevin choi: filing request now, thanks. tagging @procurement: please expedite if Legal needs to review — CloudTools timeline is tight. :thumbsup:

sophie liu: Operational checklist for submitters: 1) Complete Vendor Request form 2) Attach SOW + price sheet 3) Add budget code 4) Mark "requires MSA" if applicable 5) Route to Procurement. If value >$25k, add the "exec approval" note in the request. Exceptions: talk to finance@redwood.com.

maria gonzalez: Saved — linking the policy into my ticket. Also, where's the updated corporate card policy? I'm updating contractor expense docs.

sophie liu: Card policy link: https://redwood.internal/finance/card-policy. TL;DR: reimbursements <= $200 with receipt ok; >$200 needs preapproval. We'll run a 20-min Q&A drop-in next Tue 10:00am PT to walk through changes. :calendar: :eyes:

kevin choi: will attend. thanks all.
